set.body:
Outcome

Remove the process-global AtomicReference registry while preserving current domain semantics and making ownership lifetime explicit.

Work

- Inventory every DomainFactory and VolumeDomain construction path.
- Assign registry ownership to a concrete dataset, archive session, study/workflow context, or application service.
- Prefer pure APIs that accept DomainRegistry and return the value plus updated registry; effectful applications may place the registry in a scoped Cats Effect Ref.
- Use FiniteDomain.ephemeral for genuinely ephemeral domains.
- Preserve the existing legacy voxel ordinal convention in this task; do not substitute image4s GridDomain mechanically.
- Add typed errors for conflicting records and restoration failures.

Acceptance

- No process-global mutable registry remains.
- Independently opened resources and tests do not share implicit retained domain state.
- Fresh and restored construction canonicalize through an explicit registry and preserve owner/identity behavior.
- Lifecycle, concurrency, and cleanup responsibilities are documented and tested on JVM and Scala.js where applicable.
- No generic DomainStore[F] is published without a second downstream application requiring the same concurrency contract.
set.title: Replace process-global DomainFactory with scoped DomainRegistry ownership
